requirement: Block all clients in 10.0.1.0/24 from reaching the web server network 10.0.2.0/24.
raw_response:
r1 | vtysh -c "configure terminal" -c "ip rule add always 10.0.1.0/24 table test1"
r1 | vtysh -c "set policy parameter FORWARD default-multicast-loopback-inhibit off"
r1 | iptables -I FORWARD -s 10.0.1.0/24 -d 10.0.2.0/24 -j DROP
r1 | vtysh -c "commit configuration"
